candidates: The 8 locked ORL configurations, unchanged; no new hyperparameters.
cv: 9-fold StratifiedKFold over the 360 training images, random_state 170; each fold holds out exactly one image per person. Training seed 4000 + fold.
cv_score: Held-out predictions from the final epoch, matching the refit, which has no validation set. No epoch is chosen using held-out data.
disclosure: Proposed after the formal ORL test scores were known: the formal final model scored 95.00% and the per-config test means were visible. Any result here is therefore not a blind estimate.

environment.device_name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition
environment.reproducibility_note: Seeds, data order, and augmentation are fixed and restored on resume. On CPU, a rerun matches only with the same PyTorch build, hardware, and thread count, because floating-point reduction order depends on them. CUDA runs use deterministic algorithms with TF32 disabled, but can still differ across GPU models, drivers, and library versions. MPS offers weaker determinism guarantees. Results from different devices are not expected to match exactly.

primary_result: Test accuracy of the 3-seed ensemble (mean of softmax outputs), which needs no seed choice. Per-seed results are reported alongside.
purpose: Supplementary experiment. It does not replace the formal ORL results.
refit_rule: Selected config on all 360 training images, its fixed epoch budget, seeds [2026, 2027, 2028], final epoch kept. Normalization from those 360 images.
selection_rule: Most correct of the 360 pooled held-out predictions; then lowest mean held-out cross-entropy; then fewest parameters.
test_reads: Once, after refit, with no further changes.
